name: Fourteenth procedural city district
authoring: Original deterministic geometry and facade/road/water shader extensions authored for this project
dependencies: Installed Three.js 0.180: MIT. Sky, SSAOPass, EffectComposer and OutputPass from its bundled examples.
lighting: Analytic daylight sky, shared sun and hemisphere light, local 256px cubemap reflection capture, PMREM, distance fog
desktopPostprocessing: 4-sample targets, half-resolution 24-sample SSAO, ACES output. Narrow screens and XR bypass postprocessing.
limitations: Static reflection probe; no ray tracing. City geometry supplies parallax but is not a pedestrian exploration area. No headset performance verification.
